studies.title: Portolan charts
studies.caption: Sea charts drawn from compass bearings and sailing distances, criss-crossed by rhumb lines; the Carta Pisana is the oldest to survive.
studies.prompt: Overhead study of a thirteenth-century Mediterranean mariners parchment chart, recognizable Mediterranean shoreline in fine ink crossed by many straight rhumb lines radiating from several points; dividers and folded vellum nearby. No modern coordinate grid, no text labels or modern compass instrument.
